name: Sablevine Serpent
limits: V1 remains an immutable camera-fit rejection for the exact enbaseysnake / snakeJungleA / enSnake_Basey route; the V2 result does not rewrite that archive.

V2 changes only the fresh public visualScale profile factor to 0.55 and reuses the same original GLB and palette bytes. It accepts limited normal combat-camera fit together with its recorded binding, motion, ordinary nonlethal hit, fixture death, and Ready sequence.

The limited V2 result does not accept portraits, culling envelope, collision, long-session resource lifetime, every native ability variant, ordinary lethal damage, ragdoll behavior, or final art direction.
Direct snakeJungleA/C and other resource-prefab evidence cannot establish this distinct enbaseysnake source pair.
